## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: weak sector breadth (≤4/11) and Financials + Industrials both negative; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology lead: PANW (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.24% | 1M: +12.53%) ABOVE TREND.  
Healthcare next: TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.40% | 1M: -1.95%) RECOVERY, JNJ (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +0.16%) ABOVE TREND.  
Energy also positive: MPC (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +15.54%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Financials lag: GS (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -3.84%) BELOW TREND.  
Communication weak: TMUS (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -8.39%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -12.56%) BELOW TREND.  
Industrials soft: BA (1W: -3.81% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.03%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: PANW (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%) ABOVE TREND; TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +8.24% | 1M: +12.53%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +15.54%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -5.12% | 1M: -10.10%) BELOW TREND; CVS (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -4.89%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -8.39%) BELOW TREND; GS (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND; BAC (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Communication and Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: PANW (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%) ABOVE TREND; TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +8.24% | 1M: +12.53%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND. Watch ISRG (1W: +6.40% | 1M: -1.95%) RECOVERY for a short-term trend change.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but positive on 1W; leaders above trend while semicap names show bifurcation: AAPL (1W: +3.19% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -0.07%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: -8.06% | 1M: -18.76%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth: positive (24 stocks).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Under pressure with major banks below trend and sector 1W negative: JPM (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -3.84%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +1.56%) ABOVE TREND — overall sector weakness persists.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Relatively defensive lift but mixed internals: TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.40% | 1M: -1.95%) RECOVERY, JNJ (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +0.16%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -2.77% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth: positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective defensive and quality names within Healthcare and stable Energy while reducing exposure to large-bank cyclicals and deeply down semicap names. Monitor short-term rallies in RECOVERY names (ISRG, NVDA) as tactical opportunities, but treat market as RISK-OFF.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: BAC (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.70% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -8.06% | 1M: -18.76%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +1.91%) and Technology (1W: +2.04%) for stock-specific strength. BEARISH: Financials (1W: -2.28%) and Communication (1W: -2.82%) for downside risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA (1W: +0.45% | 1M: -0.07%) RECOVERY — failure to flip 1M positive would negate the bounce. AAPL (1W: +3.19% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND holding its 1M strength would signal tech resilience. Banks (GS/BAC) sustaining further weekly declines would confirm broader financial stress.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
TMO (+55): Thermo Fisher sees stronger demand; price ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed (TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND).  
ISRG (+75): EU approval for da Vinci SP expands market; price RECOVERY — short-term confirmation vs 1M lag (ISRG (1W: +6.40% | 1M: -1.95%) RECOVERY).  
VLO (+55): Upgraded estimates for Valero; price ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed (VLO (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND).  
AMAT (+55): India research park announced but price BELOW TREND — bullish news diverging from price, watch for distribution (AMAT (1W: -8.06% | 1M: -18.76%) BELOW TREND).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
BAC (-80): Unrealized bond-loss headlines align with price downside and sector weakness (BAC (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -8.96%) BELOW TREND) — confirming risk.  
BA (-60): Production ramp delays and negative news confirm downside momentum (BA (1W: -3.81% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF; Style: mixed / no clear leadership.  
TMO (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.85%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +0.25%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: narrow leadership and bank stress (BAC, GS below trend) plus bullish news failing to lift some names (AMAT) — watch divergences closely.
